llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究铝基复合材料耐磨性，与生物医学金属植入物方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structures, no biomedical materials, no fatigue testing, no osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究碳纳米管增强铝基纳米复合材料的微观结构和耐磨性。
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化制备复合材料并进行磨损测试。
summary_zh.validation: 磨损实验和微观结构表征。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the microstructure and wear behavior of CNTs-reinforced aluminum matrix nanocomposites fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was used to fabricate the composites, followed by wear testing and microstructural characterization.
summary_en.result: Addition of CNTs improved wear resistance due to uniform dispersion and strengthening mechanisms.
summary_en.validation: Wear tests (pin-on-disc) and SEM/TEM characterization confirmed the microstructural and wear property improvements.
